meta.name: City
meta.description: Low, gently rolling ground built up with concrete office towers, brick apartment blocks, the odd house and a dumped steel girder or two between the tanks. Every building soaks up hits, cracks and then comes down as rubble; a tower's top can be shot off on its own. About two maps in three also get one big landform: a deep valley, twin peaks, a flat open plain, a cliff wall or a mesa. Fuel tanks, power pylons and water towers stand between the buildings. With map events on, a concrete dam may hold back a lake in the deepest valley clear of the tanks.
